name: Hobbywing QuicRun WP-1060 1/10 brushed ESC
uncertainty: Hobbywing manual dimension table: WP-1060-BRUSHED 36.5 x 32 x 18 mm, 39 g. Modelled at 35.5 x 32.18 mm using the retailer spec table; capacitor block height is not published and is modelled at 6 mm above the case.
material: Epoxy potted PCB, aluminium capacitor block

features.note: This ESC expects a servo-style PWM throttle signal. The current WireUp circuit drives the L293D directly with digitalWrite + EN stepping, so the ESC is an unmodelled integration point for the 1/10 build.
